packages.title: Mine expansion packet
packages.summary: A compact before/after evidence packet for explaining how edge triage keeps low-value imagery off the downlink.
packages.teachingPoint: Compare a small evidence packet with raw imagery and ask the model what should be retained.
packages.imageAlt: Saved Sentinel-2 frame of the Atacama mining region

evidence.reviewSummary: Retained region-level expansion evidence supports review of pond-like, tailings-like, road, facility, and open-pit context without proving illegal mining, pollution, or production output.

packages.title: Ice extent quality gate
packages.summary: A deliberately cautious packet showing how cloud and no-data checks can produce an abstention instead of a false alert.
packages.teachingPoint: Ask why a model should abstain when the evidence window is not trustworthy.
packages.imageAlt: Saved Sentinel-2 frame of Greenland ice and snow extent

evidence.reviewSummary: Cloud and no-data gates keep the packet in abstention when the evidence window cannot support an extent-change claim.

packages.title: Fireline review packet
packages.summary: A review-only packet that separates smoke, cloud, burn-scar, and vegetation cues before escalation.
packages.teachingPoint: Use the model to practice separating evidence, uncertainty, and action.
packages.imageAlt: Saved false-color Sentinel-2 frame for Southeast US fireline review

evidence.reviewSummary: Smoke, cloud, burn-scar, and road-corridor cues remain candidate evidence until source-backed fire context and human review support escalation.
